description: Crypto price / live coin quote: spot price, 24-hour change and 24-hour volume for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana or any Coinbase product (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD...), read at call time from Coinbase's public market data. Use it when an agent needs a current cryptocurrency price. Input: product_id such as BTC-USD. Bid/ask: market.ticker. Whole rate table: market.rates. $0.02 per call. Returns: price, price_change_24h_pct, volume_24h, base/quote currency.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.
